text: A tiny floating island with a tomato patch and a white bunny-ish creature. Prompt says Tap the ripe crop. Day 2, 10 coins, Lv1. Tapping the tomatoes.
Tried to water but it seems I tapped the bunny (Momo) instead - a Momo panel with Assign opened. Tapping the farm plot again, lower so I avoid the bunny.
Tomatoes grew in seconds. Tutorial wants me to tap the pencil to pick the tiles Momo looks after - so Momo is an automated worker. Tapping pencil.
Momo now Working at Farm, 1/4 tiles. Other tiles are just grass - nothing else to assign yet. Confirming with the checkmark.
Momo is farming on its own: 5 jobs already, money 19, +9/min. A mail envelope popped over Momo and Mailbox has a red dot. Opening mailbox.
Cute letter from Momo proposing Field expansion research. Love the airmail card. Tapping Let's research it.
Big research tree: Farm, Lumber, Mine, Smelting, Power, Games... Field expansion needs 3 flasks + 20 coins, and I need a research lab first. Tapping Build a research lab.
Build menu: Farm 10, Mine Lv3, Lumberyard Lv2, Research lab Lv2, Special. I'm Lv1 49/95 xp. With 40 coins I'll build a second farm for now.
Second farm being built on the right tile automatically (I didn't pick the spot, it just went there). Another mail arrived. Opening mailbox.
Level 2! Research lab and Lumberyard unlocked. 54 coins. Harvesting the ripe first farm myself, then I'll try tapping empty grass to build a research lab.
Tapping empty grass opens the build menu. Research lab 40, Lumberyard 80. I have 63 - building the Research lab.
Lab building (4s). A hint says the island can grow at a highlighted spot for 30 - I have 29. Lab shows 0/1 so it probably needs a worker. Checking Hire.
Lab finished - pretty blue-roofed cottage. Hiring a second Momo costs 90. Meanwhile tutorial says tap the glowing sea to grow the island (30), I have 35. Doing that.
Island grew a new tile to the bottom right. A tip explains empty tiles build things and demolish gives half back. Little orange flags on the farms now - ripe? Got it, then mailbox.
Harvested the east farm by hand. 3 flasks now and Research has a red dot - Field expansion should be affordable. Sowing the empty farm first, then research.
4 flasks, 50 coins. Starting Field expansion research (+1 crop per harvest, 20s).
Next: City panel is a clear goal list: Land 5/9, Momo 1/3, Research levels 0/3, Value produced 138/1.5K. Nice. Plan: cheap farm on the empty tile, then save for a second Momo (90).
Level 3, Mine now needs 120 + 10 wood, so I'll need a Lumberyard (80) eventually. Next land costs 40. Building a cheap farm on this tile.
Field expansion Lv1 done; Lv2 costs 4 flasks + 38. Two new branches unlocked. I have 86 coins - I'd rather hire a second Momo first (90) for automation, then research.

Hired Mochi! It went straight to the new farm. Panel says 'Before: Research lab' and 'Manager may move' - not sure what that means, maybe it was helping in the lab. 26 coins left, +78/min. Waiting a bit to afford research.
Income jumped to 114/min with two Momos. 86 coins, 7 flasks. Harvesting the ripe east farm and going to research.
Only one research at a time ('Another research is running'). 114 coins and 150/min. Buying more land (40) toward the City goal while research runs.
Island grew south with a pretty bush tile. 128 coins. Checking what a third Momo costs (City needs 3).
Field expansion Lv2 finished: Crops +1 -> +1.25 (fractional crops, a bit odd). Third Momo is 145, I have 158 - hiring.
Pomu joined, Next: City now 1/4 - the Momo goal is met. Next I want research levels (have 7 flasks, need 40 coins for Watering efficiency).
Bigger harvests: Crops +1, 8 flasks, 60 coins, 2 min. I have 133 coins, 9 flasks. Starting it - more crops per harvest sounds better than less waiting.
Level 4 reached quietly while in research. Bigger harvests running (2 min). 100 coins: building a Lumberyard (80) on the new south tile to start wood.
Oops - the Pomu panel covers the south tile, so my tap hit Assign ('Tap a building for this Momo'). Trying to dismiss the panel by tapping the sky.
Lumberyard under construction (0/1 workers). Wondering whether a Momo will move there on its own ('Manager may move') or I have to assign one. Waiting to see.
Lumberyard is a cute little grove with logs and an axe. Already 2 wood in the top-left counter. Fell 9s / Replant actions. Nobody works it (0/1). Checking hire price for a 4th Momo.
Hired Mugi (235) - it auto-took the lumberyard tile (badge 1 on it). Four Momos now, nice little crowd. Checking research progress.
Bigger harvests 47s left. Two Momos have '...' speech bubbles - curious. Peeking at the Lumber research tab.
Lumber research Sharp axes is locked behind 'Lumber mastery Lv2' - so buildings have to level up by working first. New mail from the lumberjack Momo. Opening it.
Bought another land tile (55) - island is getting long. 194 coins, 8 wood, 10 flasks. Going back to research to queue the next one.
Bigger harvests done - City goal now 2/4 (research levels met). Greenhouse and Seed selection unlocked. Starting Watering efficiency. 303 coins, 308/min.
Mine is affordable now (120 + 10 wood, I have 320 and 12 wood). Building it on the newest tile - the wood loop paid off.
Mine building (7s), 0/1 workers. Seeing if I can afford a 5th Momo to staff it.
Mine finished - a mossy cave with a mine cart, lovely. 5th Momo is 370, I have 301. Waiting a few seconds to afford it.
A Momo already moved into the mine by itself - 2 ore in the counter. 426 coins, hiring a 5th Momo.
Tofu (5th Momo) is heading to the Research lab on its own. Income ~393/min, Lv4, City goal 2/4. The island is humming along by itself - satisfying to watch. Wrapping up.
